title: Psalm 91:11-12 — angels will guard you and lift you up
summary: Psalm 91:11-12 in English (the passage the devil quoted to Jesus): God commands his angels to guard you in all your ways and lift you up in their hands so you do not strike your foot against a stone. Hebrew reference header only; first step of the Psalm 91:11-13 build.

text.text: 11 For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
12 they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

keywords: lift you up in their hands
dash thy foot against a stone
